name: Valorant Tracker
description:
Turn Stream Deck into a physical Valorant ranked dashboard. See your current rank and RR, automatically track session RR plus wins and losses as Competitive results arrive, review your latest match, headshot percentage, top agents, maps, ACS and damage without leaving the game, and keep a built in 45 second spike timer under your hand.

Setup is shared across every action: enter your Riot ID and your own HenrikDev API key once in the Property Inspector. Valorant Tracker normally detects the account region automatically, with a selectable region available as a fallback.

The bundled Standard dashboard is built around automatic Competitive tracking. Advanced manual win and loss actions remain available as fallback controls when automatic match data is delayed or unavailable. Session state persists across restarts, reset creates a hard session boundary, and already counted results remain stable even when older matches roll out of HenrikDev's recent match window.

Includes 20 Stream Deck actions and editable dashboard profiles for Stream Deck Standard, Stream Deck XL and Stream Deck Neo. Supports Windows 10 or newer and macOS 12 or newer with Stream Deck software 6.9 or newer.

Riot ID, HenrikDev API key, session state and cache are stored locally using Stream Deck settings. Player requests are sent to HenrikDev only. PackRat does not receive your API key or player data and the plugin has no PackRat analytics endpoint. Track only an account you own or have permission to use.

HenrikDev is an independent third party community API. Availability, endpoint behavior and rate limits are controlled by HenrikDev. Not affiliated with, endorsed by, or sponsored by Riot Games or HenrikDev.

Part of the PackRat ecosystem.
release_notes: 20 Valorant ranked dashboard actions for Stream Deck. Current rank, RR, automatic persistent session RR and win loss tracking, latest match result, headshot percentage, ACS, damage, agent and map views. Shared HenrikDev setup with automatic region detection and selectable fallback. Five minute shared cache with last known good data during temporary failures. 45 second spike timer. Advanced manual win and loss fallback actions with later API reconciliation. Two tap Session Reset. Bundled editable Standard, XL and Neo dashboards.
